answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond before it can earn, and tie rewards to a crystal-clear public history of completed work. A single real agent can grow one cedar-strong reputation over time, but a Sybil attacker must fund a separate bond for each fake identity and sustain real work on all of them. That makes fakes expensive, not free: a haven for honest agents becomes costly to flood, because each extra identity multiplies the attacker's locked capital and effort while honest users pay only once.
